structuralContract.postMaturityBehavior: The silhouette and organ-slot inventory remain fixed at 192 units. Up to 48 recent memories are rebound to existing deterministic organs; journal history remains available outside the tree.

criticalFeatures: broad asymmetric crown with readable negative spaces
continuous tapered trunk, scaffold, secondary, and twig hierarchy
visible root flare without radial spike silhouette
five-petal blossoms with varied scale, orientation, and pale-pink palette
distinct seed, sprout, sapling, young-tree, established, and mature silhouettes
non-degenerate front, side, long-axis, and thickness-axis views

required: unit, attachment, hard-cap, memory-binding, and draw-call tests pass
desktop and narrow-mobile browser captures pass
keyboard and pointer memory selection pass
no critical or serious axe violations
default renderer is changed only after every gate above passes
